sources.name: Annuaire Arcade
sources.example_data_quote: Atom City (Lille): Beatmania IIDX (IIDX 30 Resident, 120Hz), Chunithm X-Verse, DanceRush Stardom, GITADORA Fuzz-Up (guitare+batterie), Groove Coaster 4MAX, Hatsune Miku Project DIVA, In the Groove 2, Jubeat, Maimai Finale, Pop'n music Unilab, Pump it Up XX (CN), Rerave Plus, Sound Voltex Exceed Gear, Synchronica, Taiko no Tatsujin HD, Wacca DX. Address 113 Rue Barthelemy Delespaul 59000 Lille. 7 EUR freeplay day.
sources.adds_over_current: France-wide per-venue cab lists far denser than ZIv stubs. Map has 92 FR venues (many other-only); Annuaire lists ~893 salles with game pages. Atom City (id 5831) already rich on ZIv notes but games[] omits maimai despite FiNALE in notes; Annuaire confirms maimai Finale + version tags. Hall U Need (id 5870) map games=['ddr'] only; Annuaire adds StepManiaX and full modern FEC lineup. DDR game page lists 20+ FR sites by version (A/A20/A20+/X/X2). Community updates through 2026-07. Best EU analog to hkarcade.fandom for France.
sources.note: URL pattern: /salle-arcade/{slug}/ and /jeu/{game-slug}/ with reverse venue lists. Department/region directory at /la-carte-de-france-des-salles-arcade/. HTML scrapeable (WordPress). Not rhythm-only: full arcade genres, but Rythme category includes IIDX, SDVX, maimai, CHUNITHM, WACCA, Taiko, PIU, DDR, etc. Site claims ~6 years, active 2026 posts.

sources.name: Arcade Belgium (location list)
sources.example_data_quote: Gate Ninety World (Nivelles): Groove Coaster 4MAX Diamond Galaxy; Jubeat Beyond the Ave.; Maimai Finale; Taiko no Tatsujin Nijiro Ver.; plus pinball/racing. Address Rue de l'Industrie 7, 1400 Nivelles. Last update 14/02/2026. Free Play Lanaken: Maimai Finale, Groove Coaster, Taiko 13, Dancing Stage EuroMIX, Guitar Hero Arcade.
sources.adds_over_current: Belgium map has 24 ZIv venues. Arcade Belgium 150 locations with named game lists. Gate Ninety (id 314) map games=['groove_coaster','other','taiko'] but AB lists maimai Finale + jubeat Beyond the Ave (missing classified slugs). Free Play Lanaken (id 307) map lacks maimai; AB lists Maimai Finale. Luna Park Reflex (id 317) is other-only pinball-heavy on ZIv; AB page exists for cross-check. Search by game title supported.
sources.note: URL pattern ab.php?l={en|fr}&r=loc&p={slug}. Forum arcadebelgium.net for updates. Fixed venues + mobile lunaparks. Not Bemani-first but music games appear when present. English+French. Copyright 2003-2026.

sources.name: Gamestate (official multi-country locator)
sources.example_data_quote: Location picker lists NL (Amsterdam ArenA, Breda, Eindhoven, Utrecht, Kerkrade, Mall of the Netherlands, De Kuip, Den Haag, Circus Zandvoort, Haarlem, Arnhem, Enschede, Groningen), BE (Gent, Antwerpen, Bruxelles), DE (CentrO Oberhausen, Potsdamer Platz Berlin, Zoo Berlin), PL (Wroclaw), SK (Bratislava).
sources.adds_over_current: Official chain store list for Western Europe FEC brand. Map already has several Gamestate BE/DE rows (e.g. Antwerpen/Bruxelles/Gent/Berlin) often with only ddr/pump/other from ZIv. Locator fills complete current chain footprint and addresses; does not publish full per-cab music-game inventories on the public site (games page is marketing, not per-store lineup).
sources.note: Useful as authoritative open/closed and address source for this chain, not as a cab database. PL/SK outside Western Europe region scope but same site.

sources.name: La Tete dans les Nuages (official centre locator)
sources.example_data_quote: Centres include Paris Opera, Les 4 Temps La Defense, Aeroville CDG, Plaisir, Carre Senart, Le Spot Evry, Noisy-le-Grand Les Arcades, Lyon Part-Dieu, Lyon Confluence, Nice CAP3000, Toulon Avenue 83, upcoming Parc Valvert. Each page has address, phone, hours, booking links. Annuaire Arcade separately documents DDR A20 Plus at La Defense and other LTDN sites.
sources.adds_over_current: Map has ~8 LTDN-named FR rows, mostly games=['ddr'] or ['other'] (ids 5880-5884 etc.). Official locator gives complete current chain + hours/addresses. Full machine lists are better on Annuaire Arcade venue pages than on the brand site (brand site markets experiences, not cab inventories).
sources.note: URL pattern /centres/{slug}/. Pair with Annuaire for cabs. Large FR FEC chain with confirmed DDR presence on Annuaire.

sources.name: Museum of the Game Arcade Map (IA/KLOV)
sources.example_data_quote: Public filter UI: country dropdown includes France, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Italy, Switzerland, Austria, etc. Search by game name, venue type (Arcade, Bar+Arcade, Museum), status Verified/Closed/Private. Map markers for public arcades, museums, events.
sources.adds_over_current: Worldwide classic/modern venue map with game filter. Stronger for classic/pinball/FEC than Japanese rhythm. May fill other-only Western EU stubs where ZIv has no machines, and discover venues missing from ZIv entirely. Exact EU venue count not extracted (JS map). Secondary to Annuaire/Arcade Belgium for rhythm cab detail.
sources.note: International Arcade Museum / KLOV. Heavy US bias in practice. Game search is the useful path for rhythm titles if catalogued. Needs deeper per-country scrape to size value.

sources.name: AURCADE
sources.example_data_quote: Arcade Levels - Zaragoza (Cuarte de Huerva, Spain): free play, Games: 144 listed, Unique Games: 8. Location pages and game pages (e.g. Wacca, Maimai Finale) link locations. Hommerson Funland (Netherlands) also present.
sources.adds_over_current: Score/high-score oriented arcade DB with location+game matrices. Sparse EU vs US but some large freeplay venues (e.g. Arcade Levels Zaragoza) with long game lists. URL pattern /locations/view.aspx?id={n}. Browse requires filters (no dump without criteria). Lower priority than Annuaire/Arcade Belgium for this region.
sources.note: Live 2026 scores/posts. Not rhythm-focused. Country coverage partial; not a systematic EU census.

summary: Western Europe (FR/DE/NL/BE/ES/PT/IT/CH/AT/LU) currently 460 map venues (198 other-only), almost all from ZIv. Dedicated structured finds: (1) Annuaire Arcade is the standout France directory (~893 salles, per-venue cab lists, rhythm game reverse indexes, active 2026) and is the closest regional peer to hkarcade.fandom. (2) Arcade Belgium lists 150 BE venues with full game lists and URL slugs (maimai/jubeat/taiko/GC present). (3) Official chain locators Gamestate (NL/BE/DE+) and La Tete dans les Nuages (FR FECs) give authoritative addresses/hours but thin cab inventories. Secondary: Museum of the Game map and AURCADE (worldwide, classic/score bias). No verified dedicated national cab databases found for Germany, Netherlands, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Switzerland, Austria, or Luxembourg comparable to Annuaire/AB; those countries still depend on ZIv plus operator sites. Comparisons: Atom City FR already ZIv-rich but Annuaire confirms versions and maimai FiNALE classification gap; Gate Ninety BE AB lists maimai+jubeat missing from map games[]; Hall U Need map ddr-only vs Annuaire DDR A20+StepManiaX.
dead_ends: clubddr.free.fr DDR France map: HTTP fetch failed (dead/unverified). joystick-arcade.com (Arcade Belgium affiliate): fetch failed. arcadelocations.net: fetch failed. blueburst.gg redirects to arcademap.app (mobile app marketing only, no open multi-venue HTML DB). pinballmap.com: pinball-only, not music games. neo-arcadia.com 'Recensement des salles d'arcade en France' forum thread: unstructured discussion, not a maintained database. Facebook 'Rhythm Gamers Europe' closed group: not a public structured source. No Germany Spielhallen cab DB, no Netherlands speelhal music-game census, no Spain salas recreativas cab wiki, no Italy sale-giochi rhythm map found that lists multiple venues with per-venue machines and opened successfully today. Google Maps/Yelp deliberately excluded as data sources.
